d: AI is changing how students learn, but it is also creating new ways to cheat. South Korea is preparing tougher penalties for students caught using AI-powered smart glasses during exams, including possible criminal charges and a three-year ban from retaking the college entrance test. The concern goes beyond smart glasses. Students around the world are increasingly using AI for homework, research and studying. As AI becomes part of education, schools face a difficult question: how do they encourage its use without letting students rely on it to do the work for them?
